{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load and clean data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')
trial_df.columns = ['patient_id', 'sample_seq', 'site', 'arm', 'severity', 'age', 'sex', 'assay_batch', 'biomarker_baseline', 'biomarker_final', 'responded']

# Recompute response rates by sex and treatment, explicitly
# Control group
control_F_rate = trial_df[(trial_df['sex'] == 'F') & (trial_df['arm'] == 'control')]['responded'].mean()
control_M_rate = trial_df[(trial_df['sex'] == 'M') & (trial_df['arm'] == 'control')]['responded'].mean()

# Treatment group
treatment_F_rate = trial_df[(trial_df['sex'] == 'F') & (trial_df['arm'] == 'treatment')]['responded'].mean()
treatment_M_rate = trial_df[(trial_df['sex'] == 'M') & (trial_df['arm'] == 'treatment')]['responded'].mean()

# Overall response rates
F_response = trial_df[trial_df['sex'] == 'F']['responded'].mean()
M_response = trial_df[trial_df['sex'] == 'M']['responded'].mean()

# Compute differences
control_diff = control_F_rate - control_M_rate  # F - M
response_diff_overall = F_response - M_response

# Baseline biomarker differences
biomarker_F = trial_df[trial_df['sex'] == 'F']['biomarker_baseline'].mean()
biomarker_M = trial_df[trial_df['sex'] == 'M']['biomarker_baseline'].mean()
biomarker_diff = biomarker_F - biomarker_M

# Treatment effect per sex
treatment_effect_F = treatment_F_rate - control_F_rate
treatment_effect_M = treatment_M_rate - control_M_rate

# Print all key values
print(f'Control group response rate (F): {control_F_rate:.4f}')
print(f'Control group response rate (M): {control_M_rate:.4f}')
print(f'Treatment group response rate (F): {treatment_F_rate:.4f}')
print(f'Treatment group response rate (M): {treatment_M_rate:.4f}')
print(f'Overall response rate (F): {F_response:.4f}')
print(f'Overall response rate (M): {M_response:.4f}')
print(f'Control group difference (F - M): {control_diff:.4f}')
print(f'Overall difference (F - M): {response_diff_overall:.4f}')
print(f'Baseline biomarker difference (F - M): {biomarker_diff:.4f}')
print(f'Treatment effect for females: {treatment_effect_F:.4f}')
print(f'Treatment effect for males: {treatment_effect_M:.4f}')"}
